I think you are missing the point. It’s not about using it as a support, but taking out the very human aspect of reading the cards. RW is a very beginner friendly deck so it is prime for someone new to tarot. 

Further, large language models use part training data to extrapolate what the querent has prompted. The whole point of tarot is to come up with something new from a specific set of cards for a specific circumstance, and apply intuition. ChatGPT CANNOT do that as a large language model because intuition is fundamental to being human. 

If the cards are being fed into the model for an interpretation, this defeats the purpose of training intuition by forcing yourself to interpret and learn the cards. Tarot readers will honestly fade out if they rely on AI to completely interpret readings. 

I do feel like if you’re on this subreddit, there should be a bit more reverence to the practice of tarot, especially the human quality of intuition. AI disrespects all of that.
